projects.title: PDgigs - Freelance Platform API
projects.description: Backend API for a freelance platform with job posting, proposals, and payment system. Built with Spring Boot and microservices architecture.
projects.longDescription: A complete freelance platform backend featuring user authentication, job posting system, proposal management, and integrated payment processing. The architecture follows microservices principles with API Gateway pattern.
features: RESTful API with proper status codes

projects.title: TaskFlow - Task Management System
projects.description: REST API for task management with teams, assignments, and real-time notifications.
projects.longDescription: Complete task management system with team collaboration features, task assignments, deadlines, and real-time notifications using WebSockets.

projects.title: E-Commerce API
projects.description: Backend for an e-commerce platform with products, cart, orders, and payment integration.
projects.longDescription: Full-featured e-commerce API supporting product catalog, shopping cart, order processing, and payment gateway integration. Includes admin dashboard endpoints.
